plan.label: Plan
plan.title: Choose how to start
plan.description: Start a free trial or choose a plan. Everything else in setup unlocks once your plan is active.

academy.label: Academy
academy.title: Create your academy
academy.description: Name your academy and pick its address. We'll set up its website for you.

branding.label: Branding
branding.title: Make it yours
branding.description: Add your logo and favicon so learners recognise your academy.

website.label: Website
website.title: Publish your website
website.description: Your website is where learners find you, sign up and enrol.

course.label: First course
course.title: Create your first course
course.description: Start with a draft. You can build lessons and publish it whenever you're ready.

blocked.plan: Start your trial or choose a plan first.

plan.trialDescription: Pick the plan you'd like to try. No card required — you decide whether to continue when the trial ends.
plan.trialRefused: Your free trial isn't available for this account. Choose a plan below to continue.
plan.trialFailed: We couldn't start your trial. Please try again.
plan.paidDescription: Your free trial has already been used or isn't available right now. Choose a plan to continue — you'll pay securely and come back here.
plan.noPlans: No plans are available right now. Please contact support.
plan.awaitingDescription: We'll unlock the rest of setup as soon as your payment is confirmed. This page updates on its own.
plan.failedTitle: Your last payment didn't go through

academy.provisioningDescription: This usually takes less than a minute. You can stay here — this page updates on its own.
academy.failedTitle: We couldn't finish setting up your academy
academy.failedDescription: Nothing you entered was lost. Try again, and contact support if it keeps failing.
academy.readyDescription: Your academy and its website have been created.

branding.logoAdded: Your logo is in place. You can change it any time.

website.publishedDescription: Learners can now visit your website, sign up and enrol.
website.unpublishedDescription: Learners can't see your website until you publish it. Review it first if you like — you can keep editing after publishing.
website.publishFailed: We couldn't publish your website. Please try again.
website.noHost: Your website address will appear here once it's ready.

course.createdTitle: Your first course is ready to build
course.createdDescription: It's saved as a draft. Add lessons in the course builder, then publish it when you're ready.
course.alreadyDescription: Build its lessons in the course builder, or add more courses from your academy.

summary.readyDescription: Everything required is done. Recommended steps can be finished any time from your dashboard.
summary.incompleteDescription: Finish the required steps to launch, or pick up where you left off later from your dashboard.
summary.finishDisabledHint: Finish becomes available once every required step is done.
summary.finishFailed: We couldn't finish setup. Please try again.

card.title: Set up your academy
card.recommendedOnly: A few recommended steps are left.
